caption:
An open grassy field bordered by two bare trees and dense brush under a clear blue sky holds a cardboard block-figure at center, a yellow DANGER sign to its left, a smaller yellow marker to its right, and a low board with a small wired box in the left foreground. For the opening stretch every element stays fixed, the figure upright and both signs vertical, with no camera drift. A bright flash and a spray of sparks then burst at the figure's base.

A mound of dark earth swells around the figure, occluding it almost completely. A violent upward burst of dirt clods and debris then fills the sky above the figure's position. A white smoke and dust cloud grows outward from the ground. The DANGER sign rotates and is shoved leftward into the cloud, while the right marker remains standing upright. Debris keeps rising and spreading, the fragments arcing high against the blue sky. The column of dust keeps climbing as the airborne debris spreads.
relations: Sparks bursting at the figure's base cause the earth mound to swell and occlude it.
The swelling mound erupts upward, launching dirt clods and debris into the blue sky.
Expanding smoke and dust cloud shoves the DANGER sign leftward and rotates it.
The right marker stays upright while the dust column climbs and debris spreads.
